# Base image specification. Defines the foundation OS and python version for the container (Required)
FROM 10.42.0.2:5000/ucloud-managed/foundation-openswe-3ca1c91e3fc3ae8f67e87-a88dcf2927d9:latest@sha256:ba7cc647802e8dadd7a8598fb02fb2e14b0cec28cd2bd9bac2f4577226521d22

# Fetch source code. same as git clone pandas-dev/pandas && git reset --hard 4fb963b6a3261940de5891323a7a9a1 but avoid network stuff; guarantee to ready
RUN git clone https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas.git /testbed && git -C /testbed checkout --detach 4fb963b6a3261940de5891323a8d217087a2a9a1
# set default workdir to testbed. (Required)
WORKDIR /testbed
# The lines above should NEVER change (except python version), so as to reuse layers.

# Install package and environment manager required by the repo.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -qq -y \
    g++ \
    gcc \
    make \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set environment variable to suppress NumPy deprecation warnings during build
ENV NPY_NO_DEPRECATED_API=NPY_1_7_API_VERSION

# Install required Python dependencies for building and testing pandas
# Using multiline RUN with bash -lc to properly activate conda environment
# IMPORTANT: Use specific NumPy version 1.12.1 for Python 3.6 (from pyproject.toml)
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c '\
    pip install --upgrade pip && \
    # Install NumPy first with specific version for compatibility \
    pip install "numpy==1.12.1" && \
    # Install other core dependencies \
    pip install "pytz>=2011k" "python-dateutil>=2.5.0" && \
    # Install Cython with compatible version range \
    pip install "Cython>=0.24,<0.29" && \
    # Install test dependencies \
    pip install "pytest>=3.1" nose "beautifulsoup4>=4.5" lxml xlsxwriter xlrd six sqlalchemy moto && \
    pip install tempita \
    '

# Install pandas in development mode so tests run against local source code
# This is essential for the golden patch to be properly tested
# Note: We're NOT pre-installing pandas from PyPI since we're building from source
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c '\
    python setup.py build_ext --inplace && \
    pip install -e . \
    '

# Verify installation with separate commands to avoid quoting issues
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'python -c "import pandas; print(\"Pandas version:\", pandas.__version__)"'
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'python -c "import numpy; print(\"NumPy version:\", numpy.__version__)"'
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'python -c "import dateutil; print(\"dateutil version:\", getattr(dateutil, \"__version__\", \"no version\"))"'
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'python -c "import Cython; print(\"Cython version:\", Cython.__version__)"'

FROM 10.42.0.2:5000/ucloud-managed/foundation-openswe-ede7449b01be2dba1a3ed-048859e7d12e:latest@sha256:b655f50ff054853ed7488ab3044d95deb0eb04302aa851f54e0b105fa4c5b03c

# Fetch source code. same as git clone pandas-dev/pandas && git reset --hard fb517bad0a5c4ab4f6576a9bc0ebbe818263917d but avoid network stuff; guarantee to ready
RUN git clone https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas.git /testbed && git -C /testbed checkout --detach fb517bad0a5c4ab4f6576a9bc0ebbe818263917d
# set default workdir to testbed. (Required)
WORKDIR /testbed/
# The lines above should NEVER change (except python version), so as to reuse layers.

# Install system dependencies required for building pandas
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
# Install git and ninja-build (required by meson) and other build essentials
# Also install libegl1, libopengl0, and libgl1-mesa-glx for Qt support (OpenGL libraries)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -qq -y git build-essential ninja-build libegl1 libopengl0 libgl1-mesa-glx && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Checkout the specific commit SHA
RUN git reset --hard fb517bad0a5c4ab4f6576a9bc0ebbe818263917d

# Set environment variables for CI build
ENV PANDAS_CI=1
ENV LDFLAGS="-Wl,--strip-all"
ENV CFLAGS="-g0"
# Set Qt platform to offscreen to avoid display requirements
ENV QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen

# Install build dependencies for pandas
# Note: meson[ninja]==1.2.1 from requirements-dev.txt includes ninja dependency
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'pip install "meson[ninja]==1.2.1" "meson-python==0.13.1" wheel "versioneer[toml]"'

# Install Cython with version constraint from requirements-dev.txt
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'pip install "Cython<4.0.0a0"'

# Install numpy with version constraints
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'pip install "numpy>=1.26.0" "numpy<3"'

# Install core dependencies from pyproject.toml
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'pip install "python-dateutil>=2.8.2" "tzdata>=2023.3"'

# Install testing dependencies from pyproject.toml and requirements-dev.txt
# Install PyQt5 as the main Qt binding for pytest-qt
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'pip install "pytest>=8.3.4" "pytest-xdist>=3.6.1" "hypothesis>=6.116.0" pytest-cov pytest-qt pytest-localserver "PyQt5>=5.15.9"'

# Install pandas in development mode with CI settings
# Using --no-build-isolation and --no-deps as shown in CI examples
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'pip install -ve . --no-build-isolation --config-settings editable-verbose=true -Csetup-args="--werror"'

WORKDIR /testbed/

# The lines above should NEVER change (except python version), so as to reuse layers.

# Install system dependencies required for building pandas/Cython extensions
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gcc \
    g++ \
    python3-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Update pip and setuptools first
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'pip install -U pip setuptools wheel'

# Install compatible Cython version (0.29.36) - newer than minimum but known to work
# Also install Tempita which is required for template rendering

# Install other development/test dependencies from requirements_dev.txt
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'pip install -r ci/requirements_dev.txt'

# Install runtime dependencies
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'pip install "python-dateutil>=2.5.0" "pytz>=2011k"'

# Clear any existing cython cache to avoid stale files
# Then build and install pandas in development mode following CI process
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'rm -rf ~/.cache/cython 2>/dev/null || true'
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'python setup.py clean --all'
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'python setup.py build_ext --inplace'
RUN conda run --no-capture-output -n testbed bash -c 'python setup.py develop'

# Base image with Python 3.13 and conda environment
FROM 10.42.0.2:5000/ucloud-managed/foundation-openswe-35e4faa0d30e4ce979b8a-eb980cbd750b:latest@sha256:dfe383c27d77992c7b8bf9c0e1e17b38bb8a655acdcac5f30f870888775648b1

# Copy the repository into /testbed
RUN git clone https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas.git /testbed && git -C /testbed checkout --detach 22bae73689e10bcdf11a1ad6056bac8aeaeaf57f
# Set workdir
WORKDIR /testbed

# Configure conda to reduce prompts and enable retries
RUN conda config --set always_yes yes --set changeps1 no && \
    conda config --set remote_connect_timeout_secs 30 && \
    conda config --set remote_read_timeout_secs 120 && \
    conda config --add channels conda-forge

# Clean conda cache and update conda to ensure latest version
RUN conda clean -a -y && \
    conda update -n base conda -y

# Install system dependencies for building pandas and Qt GUI support
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ninja-build \
    pkg-config \
    libgl1-mesa-glx \
    libxcb-xinerama0 \
    libxkbcommon-x11-0 \
    libegl1 \
    libopengl0 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Activate conda environment and set up the build environment with retry logic
# Install core and build dependencies via conda with retry on failure
RUN bash -c '\
    . /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && \
    conda activate testbed && \
    for i in {1..3}; do \
        conda install -y -c conda-forge \
            numpy>=1.26.0 \
            python-dateutil>=2.8.2 \
            tzdata>=2023.3 \
            "cython<4.0.0a0" \
            meson==1.2.1 \
            meson-python==0.13.1 \
            versioneer[toml] && break || sleep 10; \
    done'

# Install Python dependencies via pip (including testing dependencies)
# Using pip for packages where conda had network issues
RUN bash -c '\
    . /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && \
    conda activate testbed && \
    pip install \
        "hypothesis>=6.116.0" \
        "pytest>=8.3.4" \
        "pytest-xdist>=3.6.1" \
        "pytest-cov" \
        "pytest-qt>=4.4.0" \
        "pytest-localserver" \
        "coverage" \
        "PyQt5>=5.15.9" \
        "qtpy>=2.4.2"'

# Install pandas in development mode using meson-python
# This ensures the local code is used when running tests
RUN bash -c '\
    . /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && \
    conda activate testbed && \
    pip install -e . --no-build-isolation'

# Optionally install optional performance dependencies (not required for tests but might be needed)
RUN bash -c '\
    . /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && \
    conda activate testbed && \
    pip install "bottleneck>=1.4.2" "numexpr>=2.10.2"'

# Set environment variables for test execution (as per test_environment_configuration)
ENV PANDAS_CI=1
ENV PANDAS_FUTURE_INFER_STRING=1
# Set Qt platform to offscreen for headless testing (prevents GUI requirements)
ENV QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen

# Ensure the conda environment is activated by default for any subsequent bash sessions
RUN echo "conda activate testbed" >> ~/.bashrc
